Chemistry Department
Dr. Vikas Singh
Assistant Professor
Dr. Vikas Singh is an esteemed academic and researcher with over 15 years of experience in the field of Chemistry. He holds a Ph.D. in Chemistry from University of Lucknow and has been an integral part of the National P.G. College faculty since 2012. Dr. Vikas's research interests include Synthetic Organometallic chemistry and Supramolecular chemistry. He has published numerous papers in prestigious scientific journals and books in national and international publications. In addition to his research, Dr. Vikas is dedicated to teaching and mentoring students. He has developed innovative teaching methods that have significantly enhanced the learning experience for students. Under his leadership, the Chemistry department has flourished, achieving high academic standards and fostering a culture of excellence and inquiry.
Dr. Poornima Devi
Assistant Professor
Dr. Poornima is an effervescent educator and researcher with a Ph.D. in Synthetic and theoretical Organic Chemistry. She has completed her doctorate from University of Lucknow in year 2019. With over 05 years of research and teaching experience, Dr. Poornima has enhanced the quality of numerous students through deliberate and systematic inquiry.
Dr. Praveen Kumar
Assistant Professor
Dr. Praveen Kumar is a well recognized researcher and teacher. He has qualified IIT-JAM examination to pursue his masters from IIT Delhi. Afterwards, he has qualified NET and GATE, and has completed his Ph. D. in Computational Chemistry in year 2019 from IISER Pune. He has more than 05 years of teaching experience.
Dr. Rituraj Mishra
Assistant Professor
Dr. Rituraj Mishra is a learned researcher and teacher. With four years of post-doctoral experience in “Ultrafast diffusion NMR” from University of Nantes, France, he has completed his doctorate in “Long-lived states and coherences in NMR” from IIT-Delhi in 2019.He has more than 08 years of teaching & research experience.
Dr. Prashant Mishra
Assistant Professor
Dr. Prashant Mishra is an enthusiastic researcher and teacher with a Ph.D. in Surface Chemistry. He has competed his doctorate from Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Central University in year 2023. He has qualified NET-JRF and GATE examination multiple time and has also tutored M.Sc. students to qualify for the same.
Mr. Raghvendra Kushwaha
Assistant Professor
Mr. Raghvendra Kushwaha is a highly motivated and dynamic educator and qualified NET-JRF and GATE examination multiple times. He has more than 4 year of experience in teaching graduate and postgraduate students. He has completed his masters from University of Lucknow.
